label: 1. This is the new Exotic Squad group chat

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: This is the new Exotic Squad group chat

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Thank you for making this chat.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'd like to discuss the future direction that Exotic will take with its activities.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: A new group chat and that's the first thing you wanna talk about?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Let's talk about something more fun :D

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: For now, I think we should start with the discussion we need to have.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Once we finish,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: we can switch to a more casual topic.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'll do whatever Boss says!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Where do you want m eto go?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I can run over there right now!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: When she said our future direction,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: she didn't mean a physical direction hehe

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yeah, she meant what kinds of activities we're going to do in the future :)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: what exactly did you want to tell us?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It's simple.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We have to become a group

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: that both the Ark and the Outer Rim need.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That means we need to become a genuine bridge that connects the two.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Instead of only considering one side's position,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: we'll need to consider both sides.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'm lost!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I don't get waht your even talkign about!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Don't overthink it :)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: All she means is

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: whether we're in the Ark or the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: we just need to play around and have fun.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Have funnn?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'm super good at that!!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I don't have any objections to the idea either.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm going to behave from now on ;)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Isn't that right, Honey?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Honey?
I believe in you guys.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I thought we were the only ones in this chat.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Who invited you?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I did, hehe

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Seeing how I'm going to play all nice and behave from now on,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I figured it'd be good to let Honey see that for himself.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I don't know why he was so quiet tho :')
It sounded like you guys were talking about something important.
It just didn't feel right to butt in...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We're not doing any of this for show,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: but admittedly I feel relieved that {AccountData.NickName} is here too.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You can watch and see how well we're doing.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Right? Hehe

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You're glad I added you too, right, Honey?
I don't know really if I can do anything here,
but I'm looking forward to this new start with you all.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'm glad you're here too!1!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Your gonna hang out wth us right??

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Looks like everyone wants your help, Honey.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm looking forward to this too ♡♡
